connector.name: GoModel
connector.registryDescription: Self-hosted gateway aggregating upstream MCP servers behind one authenticated HTTP endpoint.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image gomodel:0.1.67. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the enterpilot account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: GOMODEL_MASTER_KEY
env.description: Gateway API key clients authenticate with; unset runs the gateway in unsafe (no-auth) mode.

env.name: MCP_SERVERS
env.description: JSON object of upstream MCP servers to aggregate, e.g. {"github":{"url":"https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/","headers":{"Authorization":"Bearer ${GITHUB_PAT}"}}}. Servers can also be declared in config.yaml or the admin dashboard.
